{{Databases}}
Three anomalies<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xoTyrdT9SZI&list=PLLGlmW7jT-nTr1ory9o2MgsOmmx2w8FB3</ref>
==Insertion Anomaly==
[[File:Capture3.png]]
Repetition of data in a table
You are repeating student information and branch information in a table, and as a result you are duplicating data in the table. This can be inefficient and lead to

==Deletion Anomaly==
If you delete all the student info then you also delete all the branch info, so you lose it

==Updation Anomaly==
You need to update all the branch info at once across the table instead of just once
==First Normal Form==
{{Main|1NF}}
First Normal Form is the default and should always be done<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mUtAPbb1ECM&list=PLLGlmW7jT-nTr1ory9o2MgsOmmx2w8FB3&index=2</ref>

Rules

# Each row should be an atomic value, no other lines
# A column should contain values of the same kind
# Each column needs a unique name
# Order of data shouldn't matter
